page.layout: One page of running text in a single column. Running head at top left, page number at top right. Signature at bottom right. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: pulum eandem admisse Syzygiam, esto eam adm serit[?] Basilides, nihil propterea efficies adversus Dallæum, donec proba-veris illam Menandri Syzygiam, eandem plane esse cū Valentiniana Bythi & Siges conjugatione, & hoc opus, hic labor est: Verùm ne aliquis adhuc supersit tergiver-sandi locus,nego Basilidem Menandri Sy-zygiam admisisse, & inter figmenta sua numerasse, & mecum negab ꝛ[?] Theodore-tus Hæret. Faf. lib. i.[?] cap. 2. nam de Me-nandro loquens, Hunc, inquit, habuere magistrum Saturnilus & Basilides, quo um ille Antiochiam ad Oorntem[?] fluvium sitã Pa-triam sibi esse prædicabat, Basilides vero Ale-xandriam, qui & magistro & sibi invicem contrarias fabulas confixere. Eat nunc Vir doctus, & Basilidi quantum volet affin-gat quam Menandri dicit esse Syzygiam; ego Theodoretum sequar, & Basilidem Menandro cōtraria excogitasse firmissimè credam. Basilides, pergit eruditus Pearso-nius, Menandri sententiam non concidit, non concidit sanè, neque id concedere molé-stum erit; sed, inquit in immensum extén-dit, pace tuâ Vir doctissime in immensum non extendit, neque de Menandri do-ctrinâ id dicit Irenæus, à quo hæc verba accepit Pearsonius, sed de ipsissimo Basili-dis impio dogmate, ecce Irenæi verba lib.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "adm serit" (broken type in the line, likely "admiserit"); "negab ꝛ" (the abbreviation after "negab" is unclear, probably "negabit"); "lib. ı." (the numeral is printed as a dotted or dotless i, read as i). Suspected printing error: "Oorntem" (probably "Orontem"), left as printed. The word "sitã" carries a tilde as printed. Italic and roman changes follow the printed type. The fragment "pulum" at the start continues from the previous page. The Google watermark at bottom right is omitted.
